items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Items 1-8 done; the pre-registered rules are evaluated unchanged; cuts (merge-base fallback, 17 failures unreproduced) disclosed.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable git or test files are reported as notes; a mutation that does not parse is skipped; probes always restore the file.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No secrets; subprocess environment scrubbed; scratch trees live outside the repo; label packs exclude evidence files.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 7 in-process tests on real git assert outcomes (mapping by name after line shift, class a/b, path reach, mutation, pack redaction).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Serial long runs by design (ADR-044); analysis steps take seconds to minutes.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All new files under 300 lines, sibling _baseline_b_* modules, ruff clean.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Reads coverage databases (real CoverageData files loaded) and JUnit XML; writes only the BL0B JSON; no existing serialized format changed.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: New tests tagged with a module-level covers mark, no skips, no weakened assertions.
